evidence.t: Mule deer and White tailed deer winter range u-4-006 unit 97953 (official), 60 m N. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), right here.
Burn from 2017 (fire N11844, 1,285 ha), right here.
Habitat zone Interior Douglas fir (IDFdm2): low winter and fall range.
Private fields 1.3 km E: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).
Elk winter range u-4-006 (official), 60 m N.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-3, Region 4 Kootenay. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Linklater Creek. Closed September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 2-57/23.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-3: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

Cranbrook Deer Hunt (Map D27): 5 to 31 January, one extra deer of either species and either sex, only inside the mapped portions of MUs 4-3, 4-4, 4-5 and 4-20. Never more than 3 deer province wide (synopsis pages 37 and 41, 99%). The Map D27 line is not in this data: check the map.

plan: Drive: from Boswell, about 161 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.00545, -115.21095, pull off on Green Rd (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.4 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 113 m, about 40 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2018 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-3, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R4B-deer-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-3: about 17,683 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 10.62 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Beginner friendly
tags.why: Quieter spot only 1.4 km from the parking: fewer hunters, short walk back (Tip, estimate).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
